captions.detailed: A compact, rectangular desktop air purifier with rounded vertical edges, finished in a matte light-gray color. It features a top exhaust grille, a side-mounted black rotary speed knob, a sliding filter tray on the opposite side, and a full-height rear service door mounted on a vertical hinge. The rear service door rotates outward to reveal the interior, the filter tray slides horizontally outward on small guide rails, and the black speed knob rotates continuously about its horizontal axis.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a compact desktop air purifier with a light-gray body, a top exhaust vent, a side-mounted black rotary control knob, a pull-out filter tray, and a hinged rear access panel. Ensure the access panel has a revolute joint on its side hinge, the filter tray has a prismatic sliding joint, and the control knob has a continuous rotational joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main purifier housing using a rounded box primitive with slots cut out of the top face for the exhaust vents. Model the rear service panel as a flat plate and attach it with a revolute articulation along its vertical edge. Create the filter tray as a flat rectangular block with a small square handle, and set it up with a prismatic sliding joint. Model the rotary speed knob as a black cylinder with small ridges, and attach it to the side of the housing with a continuous rotational articulation.
